title: wss-00 Security: 'owner's Chat record' ambiguous for group chats
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md, the Ephemeral Event Authorization security section says: 'ChatTypingEvent MUST NOT be delivered if the owner`s Chat record has receiveTypingIndicators: false at delivery time.' The term 'owner' in JMAP Chat means the user whose mailbox a server serves — i.e., the recipient of the WebSocket event. But 'owner' is also used in the main spec in other senses (chat creator, space owner). In the context of a group chat with multiple recipients, 'owner' here means each individual recipient, not a single person. The phrasing should be 'the recipient's Chat record' or 'the account's own Chat record' to eliminate ambiguity.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
